item.title: Valentine Conversation Heart Cookies
item.description: Say 'I love you!' on Valentine's Day with these yummy sugar cookies inspired by classic conversation hearts.

item.title: Sweet and Salty Chocolate Bark
item.description: You'll never guess what the secret ingredient is in this unique, sweet, and salty chocolate bark perfect for the holiday season.

item.title: Quick Cheddar Garlic Biscuits
item.description: This quick and easy Cheddar garlic biscuits recipe is ready in just 20 minutes with only five ingredients, including biscuit mix and mild Cheddar cheese.

item.title: Pineapple Nut Bread
item.description: Crushed canned pineapple, pecans, and raisins are found throughout this pineapple nut quick bread recipe with ground cinnamon your family will love.

item.title: Patacones de Colombia (Fried Plantains)
item.description: This patacones de Colombia (fried plantains) recipe is pretty straightforward, quick, and easy, plantain slices are fried, smashed, and fried again.

item.title: Orange Citrus Cheesecake
item.description: Creamy cheesecake flavored with bright orange zest is topped with a sauce made of fresh cranberries and orange juice.

item.title: Chef John's Rosemary Shortbread Cookies
item.description: Chef John's rosemary shortbread cookies are tender and crumbly with a subtle hint of rosemary, and might be even better than the classic version!

item.title: Caramel Popcorn with Marshmallow
item.description: This marshmallow caramel popcorn recipe combines three classic treats into one amazing dessert that will surely be an all-time family favorite.

item.title: Amazing Passover Chocolate Toffee Matzo
item.description: Crispy matzos with a buttery toffee coating get a topping of chocolate and a sprinkle of pecans in this traditional Passover dessert.

item.title: Sara's Beef Jerky
item.description: No smoker or dehydrator is required here. Thinly sliced sirloin or London broil steak is mixed with liquid smoke and seasonings, then baked at low temperature for 8 hours.

item.title: Flourless Triple Chocolate Cookies
item.description: These gluten-free triple chocolate cookies, made without flour, are quick and easy to make and chocolate lovers will love them.

item.title: Crab and Jack Pretzel
item.description: Jumbo soft pretzels, topped with hot crab and cheese, are an East Coast favorite and a crab-lover's dream.

item.title: Magaricz
item.description: Chopped eggplant, red and green bell peppers, onions, and carrots, slowly cooked on the stovetop in olive oil will make your kitchen smell like heaven. A wonderful dip for rye--or your favorite bread or crackers.

item.title: Pizza Toast with Burrata and Tomato
item.description: Burrata adds an extra creamy topping to this pizza toast that is a perfect quick and easy lunch.
